protocol.name: reprise_on_top_v1
protocol.copyright: reprise private protocol: a program's window kept above the others.

interface.name: reprise_on_top_v1

description.summary: keep a toplevel above the windows that are not

interface.description: One global. A program asks for one of its toplevels to stay above every window that is not on top itself, as the window menu's Always on Top does, and hears when that changes by the window menu, a key or a window rule.

request.name: set

description.summary: keep toplevel on top, or not

request.description: Asked before toplevel maps, it holds from the map on, unless a window rule says otherwise. Ignored when toplevel belongs to another client.

arg.name: on_top
arg.summary: 1 to keep it on top, 0 not

event.name: changed
event.description: Sent once toplevel maps, and on each change after that, whatever made it, a set request included.
